# Version 4.151.2
> **Skia m151 servicing** · Released August 29, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.2) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.2/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.102/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.2 refreshes Skia m151 and co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102. The co-shipping HarfBuzzSharp package adds Tag.Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>) for parsing slices without substring allocations. The native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **M151 servicing update** — Refreshes the same-milestone native revision while preserving SkiaSharp's managed API, C API, and native dependency versions. ([#4692](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4692))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.102 first publishes Tag.Parse(ReadOnlySpan<char>), avoiding substring allocations when parsing tags from a larger buffer. This is a package/API change; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.2.1.
